items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I'd been to her house several times during the week... she put her razor up there and said, 'You going to my house tonight, Bouchand ?'

ctx.x: Closing night she Shanghaied me at the -- met me at the stage door and put her razor up there and said, "You going to my house tonight, Bouchand ?" I said, "NO, we're going on to Chicago." "You ain't going to Chicago, you're going to my house."
